meta.title: Chuyển Xanh – Hanoi Low Emission Zone
meta.description: Check in 30 seconds whether your vehicle is restricted in Hanoi's low emission zone, work out the cost of switching to electric, and see what support you can get.

nav.label: Navigation

hero.title: Riding into central Hanoi tonight? Check if your vehicle is allowed.
hero.sub: Since 1 July 2026, Hanoi has been piloting a low emission zone inside Ring Road 1. Some areas ban vehicles at certain hours, others only discourage them, and the rules tighten every year. Pick your vehicle, place and time to get an answer, with the legal basis.

cost.title: How long until an electric scooter pays for itself?
cost.sub: Enter how far you usually ride and Chuyển Xanh does the rest. Buses and the metro are included, because sometimes you don't need a new vehicle at all.
cost.batteryHint: Leave 0 if the battery comes with the scooter.
cost.pricesHint: These are sample prices. Change them to what you actually pay.
cost.fine: Emissions use roughly 2.3 kg of CO₂ per litre of petrol. Indirect emissions from power generation are not included.
cost.empty: Enter a distance to see the comparison.
cost.notCheaper: With these numbers, an electric scooter isn't cheaper than petrol each month. Check the battery rental fee, or consider the bus or metro.
cost.save: An electric scooter saves about {money} a month compared with petrol
cost.payback: , paying for itself in about {months} months ({years} years).
cost.noUpfront: , with nothing extra to pay upfront.
cost.co2: Each year you burn about {litres} fewer litres of petrol, roughly {kg} kg of CO₂ from the exhaust.
cost.busTip: If your route has a bus or metro, that's the cheapest option each month.

support.title: Can you get money to switch?
support.sub: Under Resolution 68/2026/NQ-HĐND of the Hanoi People's Council, in effect from 1 July 2026 to the end of 2027.
support.amountNote: maximum, for members of poor households
support.body: Covers 100% of the price of a new vehicle, based on a legal invoice including VAT. A VND 18M scooter gets VND 18M; a VND 25M scooter gets VND 20M and you pay VND 5M. One vehicle per person, once.
support.c1: You belong to a poor household under Hanoi's multidimensional poverty standard for 2026 or 2027.
support.c2: Your "place of residence" or "current address" on VNeID is in Hanoi, confirmed by the commune-level People's Committee.
support.c3: You own a petrol motorbike registered before 1 July 2026.
support.c4: You transfer or remove the old vehicle from the low emission zone, and register the new one while the policy is in effect.
support.callout: Earlier drafts proposed support for near-poor households and the general public too. Chuyển Xanh has not seen these confirmed in the final resolution, so they are not listed as guaranteed. Ask the People's Committee of your ward.
support.docsHint: As of 3 Nov 2026, the Department of Construction is still drafting the claim procedure. Tick what you already have; your browser will remember.
